title: Minecraft Franchise Overview
body:
Minecraft began as an independent project by Markus Persson and was first released publicly in 2009, reaching full release in 2011, and later grew through console, mobile and education editions and spin-off games, all documented in public release records.

This public edition records only verifiable facts — edition titles, developers, release years and formats — in original wording, with no copied game text.

The companion Signature edition is separate, labeled unofficial fiction with original builders and block-worlds, and it claims no affiliation with or endorsement by Mojang or Microsoft.

How to use this record: start with the overview, then read the work-by-work records in publication order. Every date and credit below is a public fact; no copyrighted text is reproduced anywhere in this database.

title: Minecraft Reading and Viewing Order Guide
body:
Recommended public order for the works in this database is publication and release order, beginning with Minecraft (Java Edition, full release) (2011) and ending with A Minecraft Movie (2025). That order follows how the franchise actually reached the public, and it avoids assuming any later reordering.

The full order is: Minecraft (Java Edition, full release) (2011); Minecraft: Pocket Edition (2011); Minecraft (console editions) (2012); Minecraft Realms (2013); Minecraft: Story Mode (2015); Minecraft: Education Edition (2016); Minecraft (Bedrock Edition) (2017); Minecraft Dungeons (2020); Minecraft Legends (2023); A Minecraft Movie (2025). Each title in that list has its own record in this database with its credited creators and format.

This guide contains facts only. It does not reproduce story text, and it does not claim that any Signature continuation belongs in the official order.
